story.title: China Launches Shenzhou 24 with Two Chinese and One Pakistani Astronaut
story.summary: China has successfully launched the Shenzhou 24 spacecraft, carrying two Chinese astronauts and one Pakistani astronaut. This mission marks the first time a foreign astronaut has joined a crew on a Chinese space station. The crew is set to conduct over 90 scientific experiments and technology tests during their time in space.

timeline_highlights.title: Voyager 1 Achieves Distance Milestone of One Light-Day from Earth
timeline_highlights.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 has reached a significant milestone, becoming the first human-made object to travel one light-day from Earth, which is over 16 billion miles. Launched in 1977, the spacecraft continues to send data back from interstellar space as it approaches its 50th anniversary next year.
key_facts: Voyager 1 is over 16 billion miles from Earth.
The spacecraft was launched in 1977.
It is the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth.

timeline_highlights.title: Voyager 1 Reaches Record Distance, Communicates from One Light-Day Away
timeline_highlights.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 has successfully communicated with Earth from a distance of over 16 billion miles, equivalent to one light-day. This milestone marks the farthest any human-made object has traveled since its launch in 1977. The signal was received exactly 24 hours after it was sent from the spacecraft.

related_stories.title: Russian Strikes Kill Seven in Ukraine; Kyiv Targets Refineries
related_stories.summary: Russian drone attacks resulted in the deaths of seven people across six Ukrainian regions, targeting infrastructure including a gas production facility and a thermal power plant. In response, Ukraine launched drone strikes on Russian oil refineries in the Samara and Rostov regions, as well as an airbase in Nizhny Novgorod, leading to at least one reported death in the Samara region.

related_stories.title: North Korea Orders Closure of Swiss Diplomatic Office and Expels Envoy
related_stories.summary: North Korea has expelled a Swiss diplomat and demanded the closure of Switzerland's newly opened diplomatic office in Pyongyang. This action follows Switzerland's recent sanctions against a camp accused of indoctrinating Ukrainian children, which North Korea condemned. The Swiss office was inaugurated on October 19 during a visit by Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis.

related_stories.title: Record Number of Migrants Arrive in Canary Islands in One Day
related_stories.summary: Nearly 2,000 migrants arrived in the Canary Islands in a single day, marking a record for the archipelago. The maritime rescue service reported that 1,990 individuals reached the islands aboard 15 boats, with many departing from Senegal and Gambia. This surge in arrivals coincides with Spain's upcoming elections, prompting concerns about unprecedented migration pressure on the region.

related_stories.title: Estimates of Russian Soldier Casualties in Ukraine Reach 700,000 Amid Kremlin Silence
related_stories.summary: Recent estimates suggest that over 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the Ukraine war, based on leaked data from Russia's official statistics agency. This figure, which includes death certificates registered until the end of August, highlights the significant toll of the conflict. The Kremlin has declined to comment on these reports, stating that only the defense ministry can provide official casualty figures.
